text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents CRAFTY-Sweden, an agent-based land-use model explicitly implemented at the national scale of Sweden (1 km² resolution) to simulate future land-use change in the forestry and agricultural sectors from 2010 to 2100. The primary research objective is to explore future land-use change and ecosystem service provision under multiple combined socio-economic and climate scenarios (five SSP-RCP combinations). The study includes quantitative spatial outputs (e.g., mapped distributions of land owner types and land-use categories, hotspot maps of change), reports percentage changes in land-use and management roles by region, and compares outcomes across scenarios using metrics such as timber harvest volumes, forest age dynamics, and land conversion rates. Although ecosystem services are a key focus, LULC prediction is central to the modeling framework and analysis, satisfying all core inclusion criteria and avoiding exclusion criteria.)
